title: Master Services Agreement
key_sentences: “Business Day” means a day other than a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in England when banks in London are open for business.
This Agreement starts on 1 November 2026 and continues for an initial term of thirty-six months.
If the Supplier fails to meet the availability level in any month, the Client shall be entitled to the service credits described in Schedule 1.
The Client shall pay each valid invoice within thirty days of receipt, by bank transfer to the account notified by the Supplier in writing.
Nothing in this Agreement limits either party’s liability for death or personal injury caused by its negligence, or for fraud.
On termination the Supplier shall make the Client’s data available for download in a standard format for thirty days, after which it shall be deleted.

notes: Commercial services agreement, three fixed pages, no letterhead. The footer has three parts (short title, page number, initials blanks); the short title and initials line repeat and are listed once, "Page n of 3" once per page. Clause numbers such as "1.1" and "4.2" are paragraph numbers, NOT list items, and they are part of the paragraph text; key sentences inside numbered clauses are given without the clause number. The parties "(1)", "(2)", the recitals "A.", "B." and the sub-clauses "(a)" to "(d)" are typed-marker list items. Definitions are ordinary paragraphs. Curly quotes and apostrophes are as printed. The two signature blocks at the end sit side by side and are read box by box, left first; they are body text. Schedule 1 holds two separate ruled tables.
